noImageUrls: No image URLs have been added to the Art Frame Images list in the app settings

settings.artFrameImagesDescription: Add image URLs for the Art Frame devices, one per line. The URLs must be reachable from the internet so the SwitchBot cloud can fetch the images. Use the device buttons or Flow cards to show the images on a frame. Note: due to a SwitchBot API limitation, a newly uploaded image waits in the SwitchBot mobile app until it is synced there once, before the frame can show it or step to it.
settings.confirmSendDeviceLog: Send the device log contents to the developer?
settings.confirmSendInfoLog: Send the information log contents to the developer?
settings.confirmSendStatusLog: Send the status log contents to the developer?
settings.statisticsDescription: Live BLE service-data statistics for the registered devices.
settings.confirmClearStatistics: Clear BLE statistics counters and keep Last Seen values?
settings.statisticsCopyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Please select and copy the table manually.
settings.oauthMissingSessionText: Please log in to use the Get HUB Devices feature.
settings.oauthLoginStartError: Error initiating login. Please try again. If this persists, check your OAuth2 client configuration.
settings.oauthLoginOpened: A browser window has opened with the SwitchBot login page. After login, return here. The Get HUB devices button will be available once authenticated.
settings.oauthLoginRequiredFirst: Please log in with your SwitchBot account first by clicking the Login with SwitchBot Account button.
settings.bleOnlyDetectedNotice: No cloud connection is required for BLE-only setups. This tab needs a SwitchBot cloud login to list HUB-registered devices. See the BLE Devices tab for locally detected BLE devices, whether paired or not.
settings.numConnections: Number of Homeys connected to your SwitchBot account
settings.driverSupportNotAdded: Supported but not added to Homey
settings.driverSupportAdded: Supported and already added to Homey
settings.driverSupportNotSupportableDevices: No useful status, commands, or webhooks exposed by the SwitchBot API
settings.driverSupportSendTitle: Click to send unsupported device information to the developer
settings.driverSupportFetchFailed: Failed to fetch driver support data
settings.driverSupportConnectLogin: Log in with your SwitchBot account before checking driver support.

settings.bleSettingsDescription: Options that control how the app reads data from BLE devices.
settings.bleAdvertisementsHint: When enabled, the app subscribes to advertisements for each BLE device instead of polling them. On some Homey firmware an active subscription stops service data being returned, which prevents devices updating. Leave this off if your BLE devices stop reporting values.
settings.bleAdvertisementsUnsupported: This Homey does not support BLE advertisement subscriptions.
settings.bleAdvertisementsPolling: Using polling for all BLE devices.
settings.bleDevicesDescription: Actively scans for nearby SwitchBot BLE advertisements, independent of any cloud connection. Devices are listed whether or not they have been added to Homey.
settings.noBLEDevicesDetected: No BLE devices detected yet. Click Scan Now to search.
settings.allBLEDevicesDescription: Every BLE advertisement seen during a scan, including devices that could not be added to the list above. The Reason column shows why each one was rejected.
settings.noAllBLEDevicesRecorded: No devices recorded yet. Run a scan with recording enabled.
settings.recordedDevicesCopied: Recorded devices table copied to clipboard.
